prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated transparent hood accessory for modular Pixel Operators robot avatars.
Subject: ONLY a close-fitting graphite fabric hood rim shaped like an inverted U with a broad flat crown and softly clipped square corners. Thin padded frame, subtle seams and a few chunky silver-gray pixel highlights. Front elevation, perfectly symmetrical. No pointed peak, no trailing fabric, no shoulder cape, no hanging straps, no buckles, no cords.
Precise silhouette: squared outer shape about 1.2 times wider than tall. Frame thickness approximately 7% of total width at sides and 9% of height at crown. A very large genuinely transparent squared central opening occupies about 84% of outer width. The two narrow straight side pieces terminate flush at the bottom, at equal height, open bottom. This slim rim will wrap snugly just outside a separately drawn terminal robot head, never cover its screen or extend down to the torso.
Style: crisp chunky retro pixel-art raster, neutral graphite charcoal fabric with restrained silver edge shading, stepped pixel contours and flat limited tones. Restrained hardware-like fabric, matching a friendly terminal robot avatar. Readable at 24px.
Composition: one isolated accessory centered with generous transparent padding on square canvas. Genuine alpha transparency outside AND through the entire center opening.
Constraints: NO robot head or face inside, no body, eyes, screen, neck, letters, logo, watermark, scene or checkerboard backdrop. Only the thin inverted-U hood rim. No extra protrusions or attached objects.
